messages:
incident-bot: PAGED: Canary alert - canary group 'release-2026-03' hitting 40% 500s on inference-api (region: us-west)
Maya (oncall): seeing the same. 503s from the router to model-proxy. Canary started ~09:12 UTC per deploy-bot. rolling 10% -> 30% now.
Maya (oncall): kubectl logs show liveness probes failing on new pods, crashloopbackoff. grabbing pod describe.
Maya (oncall): ``` 
kubectl describe pod inference-api-canary-abc123
Events:
  Warning  Unhealthy  2m  kubelet  Readiness probe failed: HTTP probe failed with statuscode: 502
  Warning  BackOff    1m   kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container
``` 
Jon (release): deploy-bot shows image tag used: ghcr.io/redwood/inference:release-2026-03-15. Is that pinned to a digest?
deploy-bot: deploy started 2026-03-15T09:12:08Z - image: ghcr.io/redwood/inference:release-2026-03-15 - target: canary 10% -> 30%
Ekaterina (build-eng): quick check: that tag was re-pushed this morning after a CI re-sign step. We may have a mutable tag problem.
Maya (oncall): how did the re-push happen? CI should never re-upload same tag without bumping.
Ekaterina (build-eng): looks like the signing workflow retried against the mutable tag when the registry had a transient timeout; the action re-uploaded an image and signed it, effectively changing the digest behind the tag. skopeo inspect shows different digests across nodes.
Maya (oncall): ```
skopeo inspect docker://ghcr.io/redwood/inference:release-2026-03-15
# from worker A
Digest: sha256:aaa111...
# from worker B
Digest: sha256:bbb222...
```
Sam (support): customer impact? Which customers hit this canary? Any paid tenant errors?
Maya (oncall): initial telemetry: increased 500s for a subset of requests routed to canary. Most traffic is still ok on stable. No sign of data corruption yet. calling it partial outage for canary tenants :rotating_light:
Jon (release): immediate plan: stop the canary rollout (kill switch), prevent traffic expansion, mark release-2026-03-15 as blocked. Then rollback canary pods to the previous stable digest. Also inform infra to block mutable tags in the pipeline.
Maya (oncall): applying kill-switch: setting feature flag rollout.pause=true for inference-api via flags service.
Maya (oncall): @deploy-bot please pause rollout.
deploy-bot: Acknowledged. Rollout paused at 30% canary. No further waves will be promoted.
Ekaterina (build-eng): I'll fetch the last-good digest from registry GC logs and publish pinned digest for rollback. Recommend we revert to ghcr.io/redwood/inference@sha256:ccc333... (previous stable)
Maya (oncall): initiating immediate rollback of canary pods to pinned digest.
Maya (oncall): ```
kubectl set image deploy/inference-api inference-api=ghcr.io/redwood/inference@sha256:ccc333... --record
``` 
Maya (oncall): pods spinning up, readiness passing on new pods.
Maya (oncall): canary error rate dropping back to baseline. monitoring showing successful probes :white_check_mark:
Sam (support): drafting status update: "We detected a partial canary failure during today's release; immediate rollback completed and expansion paused. No customer data was modified. Support tickets: please tag with incident-2026-03-15-canary."
Jon (release): root cause: CI signing workflow allowed a re-push to a mutable tag after a retry path. Remediation: enforce digest pinning in deploy manifests and make signing job write immutable artifact entries. Also add registry policy to reject tag overwrites for release-*.
Ekaterina (build-eng): followups I will own: 1) block mutable tag pushes in CI (short-term), 2) add a guard in signing pipeline to fail on non-empty tag, 3) CI change to publish immutable artifacts to artifact db. I'll open PRs and link.
Maya (oncall): creating incident ticket and assigning to Ekaterina + Jon for postmortem. Also scheduling a 1hr oncall handoff to review telemetry in case of rollback regressions.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0315-01 - "Canary failure from mutable tag retag" - Severity: S2 - Pager cleared
Sam (support): posting customer-facing note in #status: "We identified and mitigated an issue affecting a small subset of canary traffic during a release. A rollback was performed and the release is paused while we investigate."
Jon (release): long-term: ensure deploy tooling always pins to digest (helm values: image.digest) and make deploy pipeline fail if tag is mutable. add e2e that verifies identical digest across registry mirrors.
Maya (oncall): thumbs: :thumbsup: Good mitigation. Closing ephemeral pages; leaving incident open for follow-up. I'll hand off to night oncall in 30m.
Ekaterina (build-eng): adding logs and reproducer steps to the incident ticket. Also will add a watch for signed-image retag events in registry logs.
Sam (support): I'll queue a proactive outreach to the few customers who hit errors and link to the status update.
Maya (oncall): last note: postmortem to include timeline, why mutable tag allowed, mitigation steps, and verification that registry retention/GC didn't reintroduce old digests.
Jon (release): thanks everyone. good quick coordination. :eyes:
